description: The tag-filtered read (D5) with an optional embedding rank (T3). The tag filter runs first and always; `queryText` ranks the tag-filtered set WITHIN it only (D6 — a learning the tag filter excluded is never pulled in by a similar vector). Here one tag prefix (`go*`) narrows the set, and every result still carries its provenance and, for the observed one, its count (M3). Without an embedding route the set is returned unranked (D5: no route is the normal state, not a degraded one).

learnings.body: nil-map writes panic — checked once, remembered forever
wrap errors with %w to keep the chain
